topic_title: Reduce Risk — Zero Tolerance Practices & Impairment
prompt: What legal liability can social hosts face in Texas if they knowingly serve alcohol to minors who crash?

options.text: Zero liability because personal residences are protected private properties
Criminal misdemeanor charges and substantial civil liability for injuries and death
Hosts face only a ten-dollar civil noise ordinance municipal citation
Liability falls solely on the bartender who sold the sealed alcohol bottles
